SUPERSEDED.status: SUPERSEDED - DO NOT CITE AS DETERMINISM EVIDENCE
SUPERSEDED.what_this_file_is: the run 1 vs run 2 comparison of the OI1 strict-determinism probe
SUPERSEDED.why_superseded: this file records "warn_only": false, but the run it describes actually executed under warn_only=True. utils.set_seed unconditionally sets use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True), and build_arm re-seeds internally because G13 requires it, so enforcement was silently downgraded at two points that were not re-imposed at the time. The recorded value came from the configuration the probe INTENDED, not from the live flag.
SUPERSEDED.the_claim_that_is_withdrawn: any statement that strict determinism was in force during this run, including "STRICT DETERMINISM CONFIRMED" where it appears below
SUPERSEDED.what_replaced_it: determinism_probe_run3.json, determinism_probe_run4.json and determinism_probe_comparison_strict.json, which read the LIVE flag at the point of use and record it under verified_at_use
SUPERSEDED.how_to_tell_them_apart: runs 3 and 4 carry a verified_at_use block; runs 1 and 2 do not. The machine-readable determinism block is byte-identical between the false and the true runs, so the presence of verified_at_use is the ONLY reliable discriminator inside the artefacts themselves.
SUPERSEDED.hours_still_charged: yes. Superseding the evidence does not refund the GPU hours; runs 1 and 2 remain charged to the pretrained identity in core_resource_projection_20260807.json.

determinism_probe_comparison.strict_determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False) with the flash and mem-efficient SDPA backends disabled and the deterministic math backend enabled
